page_title: ACM 1-0 NAP | AC Milan v Napoli 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Napoli couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Mike Maignan (AC Milan) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
90+6' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Theo Hernandez (AC Milan).
90+5' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+4' The ball is behind the touchline and AC Milan will take a throw-in.
90+2' Referee Daniele Doveri signals NO PENALTY for Napoli after a VAR review!
90+1' Referee Daniele Doveri makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Napoli. Let’s see what happens!
90+1' Surely that's handball by one of the AC Milan players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' Here's the change. Juan Jesus leaves the pitch and Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) comes on as a substitute.
89' Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) squanders a great opportunity after striking the ball onto the post!
87' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Theo Hernandez, who fails to shoot.
85' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Juan Jesus (Napoli) for a tough tackle.
83' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
82' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
82' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from AC Milan was in an offside position.
81' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
81' Stefano Pioli has decided to substitute Christian Pulisic and he is replaced by Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan).
80' Today's match ends for Olivier Giroud who will be replaced by Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
80' Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) tested Mike Maignan with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
79' Matteo Politano (Napoli) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
77' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
76' Walter Mazzarri has decided to make a change. Mathias Olivera (Napoli) replaces Pasquale Mazzocchi.
76' A substitution has been made. Piotr Zielinski goes off and Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) comes on.
74' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
73' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
70' That was close by Rafael Leao (AC Milan)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
68' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Mike Maignan.
68' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mike Maignan is quickest to intercept the ball.
67' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jan-Carlo Simic (AC Milan) for Simon Kjaer.
65' Stefano Pioli prepares a substitution. Ismael Bennacer is replaced by Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
65' The game is interrupted now, Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
64' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

63' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Pierluigi Gollini with a fabulous save.
63' The referee signals a corner kick to AC Milan.
61' The free kick from long range, taken by AC Milan, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
60' Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
59' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
58' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Napoli will have a corner.
57' Surely that's handball by one of the AC Milan players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
55' Walter Mazzarri decides to make a substitution. Giovanni Simeone will be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
55' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
53' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
53' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
52' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
50' Matteo Politano (Napoli) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
48' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Pierluigi Gollini easily deals with the threat.
46' Walter Mazzarri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Matteo Politano (Napoli) comes on the pitch for Leo Ostigard.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Napoli are ruled offside.
45+1' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
43' It's a throw-in for Napoli.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Napoli, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
40' Daniele Doveri couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) and blew his whistle.
38' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
37' Problems for Stefano Pioli as Davide Calabria (AC Milan) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Alessandro Florenzi replaces him.
35' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) latched onto a loose pass on the edge of the box and let fly, but Pierluigi Gollini saw it all the way and made a fine save to deny him.
34' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
33' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Leo Ostigard (Napoli) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. There is a free kick near the sideline to AC Milan.
31' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
30' A pass by Yacine Adli (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
29' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
29' AC Milan win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
28' A snap shot by Rafael Leao (AC Milan) from the edge of the area flies towards the top right corner, but Pierluigi Gollini produces a good reflex save to thwart him.

25' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Rafael Leao, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), who beats Pierluigi Gollini with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
24' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
20' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
17' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
16' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
15' An attempted cross from Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is cleared.
15' Referee Daniele Doveri sees the trip by Yacine Adli (AC Milan) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
14' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
13' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Rafael Leao (AC Milan), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
10' A sweet pass inside the box gives Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
9' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
5' The linesman signals a throw-in for AC Milan.
4' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
3' Neat passing move from Napoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
Napoli will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri will referee today's match.
